description: Defines the BankCard class representing a virtual/physical bank card, including serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: BankCard
classes.description: Represents a bank card linked to an account with properties such as id, accountId, maskedPan, holder, brand, status, and expiry. Provides methods for JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the BankCard instance into a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a BankCard instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: encodeList
methods.description: Serializes a list of BankCard objects into a JSON string.

methods.name: decodeList
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a list of BankCard objects.
